_about: Crowd actions from tools/blender/build_crowd.py, for animating instanced racegoers in a vertex shader. Per rig, per action: duration (seconds, loops) and frames (24 per second); each frame holds one rigid transform per bone in glTF axes, [qw, qx, qy, qz, tx, ty, tz], to apply to the rest-pose vertices that bone owns (`_bone` attribute): v' = q * v + t. Bones in order: body, head, upper_arm.R, forearm.R, upper_arm.L, forearm.L.
